$2.5 billion aggregate principal of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 issued, ~$2,462.3 million net proceeds.

Commvault disclosed that it issued $900 million in convertible notes during fiscal 2026, along with $99.6 million spent on related capped-call purchases.
Commvault reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $314.1 million, up 11% year over year, and subscription ARR of $1,054 million, up 22% year over year, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
CrowdStrike reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $1.47 billion, up 26% year over year, for the quarter ended 2026-07-31.
CyberArk ceased to exist as an independent SEC filer and public entity, absorbed into Palo Alto Networks.
Cyera completed its acquisition of Ryft.
Cyera raised $600 million led by Evolution Equity Partners at a $12 billion valuation.
Cyera completed its acquisition of Oasis Security.
Cyera announced a $400 million growth-equity investment from Goldman Sachs Alternatives at a valuation of over $12 billion.
Timothy Regan appointed Chief Financial Officer of Delinea.
Accenture disclosed an agreement to acquire a majority stake in Dragos, along with all of runZero and NetRise, in a filing accompanying its Q3 FY2026 earnings, dated June 18, 2026.

HiddenLayer raised a $100 million Series B round led by Delta-v Capital, with participation from Ten Eleven Ventures, Morgan Stanley, M12, and Booz Allen Ventures, and reported signing more than 50 new platform customers.
JFrog reported Q2 2026 revenue of $163.8 million, up 29% year over year, including cloud revenue of $87.5 million, up 53% year over year and equal to 53% of total revenue.
Check Point Software Technologies completed its acquisition of Lakera AI during the fourth quarter of 2025, for approximately $190 million in net cash consideration.
Ranjan Singh appointed CEO effective June 25, 2026, succeeding Marc van Zadelhoff.
CFO Drew Del Matto disclosed intention to retire; remains CFO while successor is sought, then transitions to advisory.
$3.5 million in restructuring costs recognized in Q2 FY2027 ended July 31, 2026.
Q2 FY2027 revenue $220.5 million, +29% YoY; ARR $899 million, +27% YoY.
Q2 FY2027 revenue $805 million, +11% YoY.
Optiv closed a lender agreement amending and extending its First Lien Credit Agreement to August 2028 and Second Lien to August 2029.

Optiv announced the sale of its advisory, consulting and transformation (ACT) project-based services business to Vobis Ventures; the deal closed June 1, 2026. Optiv said its managed services and staff augmentation remain in-house.
Palo Alto Networks closed its acquisition of CyberArk Software Ltd. for approximately $25 billion in equity value.
Palo Alto Networks reported Q4 FY2026 revenue of $3.41 billion, up 34% year over year, for the quarter ended 2026-07-31.
With the acquisition of Keyless now complete, Ping adds Zero-Knowledge Biometrics to its portfolio. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Qualys reported Q2 2026 revenue of $182.2 million, up 11% year over year, for the quarter ended 2026-06-30.
Rapid7 appointed Wael Mohamed as Chief Executive Officer. Corey Thomas, CEO for 13+ years, became executive chairman.
Rapid7 approved a workforce reduction of approximately 12% with estimated charges of $10 million to $11 million, primarily for severance and benefits.
Rapid7 reported Q2 2026 revenue of $210.9 million, down 1.5% year over year, for the quarter ended 2026-06-30.

Rubrik announced that Brian McCarthy, President of Global Sales and Field Operations, resigned effective February 6, 2026, and promoted Jesse Green, previously President of Rubrik Americas, to Chief Revenue Officer.
Rubrik reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $427.3 million, up 38% year over year, and subscription ARR of $1.66 billion, up 33% year over year, for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.
SentinelOne disclosed an 8% workforce reduction and approximately $25 million in charges in an SEC filing dated 2026-05-28.
SentinelOne reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $292 million, up 21% year over year, for the quarter ended 2026-07-31.
Q2 FY2027 revenue $308.8 million, +16.8% YoY; ARR $1,230.7 million, +25.3% YoY.
Sonatype named three new C-suite executives: Casey Watson as Chief Revenue Officer, Jason McClelland as Chief Marketing Officer, and Sherri Manning as Chief Human Resources Officer.
S&P affirmed Sophos' B- credit rating and noted expected need to refinance 2027 maturities.
Moody's downgraded Sophos to B3 from B2, with outlook revised to stable.
Cisco disclosed a $1 billion restructuring charge in an 8-K filing, including charges related to Splunk integration.
F5 completed its acquisition of SurePath AI for $50.1 million, recording $39.1 million of goodwill; F5 stated the transaction's impact on its operating results was immaterial.
Tenable reported Q2 2026 revenue of $268.5 million, up 8.6% year over year, for the quarter ended 2026-06-30.
Tenable completed the issuance of $800 million of 0.25% convertible senior notes due 2031.

Tenable entered into a credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent for a senior secured revolving credit facility of $400.0 million, including a $40.0 million sublimit for letters of credit; as of the effective date the company had no outstanding revolving loans and approximately $200,000 of outstanding letters of credit under the facility.
Trend Micro cut FY2026 operating-income guidance from ¥56.4 billion to ¥44.4 billion, citing rising artificial-intelligence and cloud-computing costs.

Varonis and Proofpoint announced a definitive agreement for Proofpoint to acquire Varonis in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $6.3 billion, or $49.75 per share. The companies expect closing in the first half of 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals; they remain separate companies until closing.

Varonis announced a 5% headcount reduction, approximately 120 employees, disclosed with its Q3 2025 results; CEO Yakov Faitelson described it as reallocating resources toward the highest return on investment.
Varonis disclosed plans to end-of-life its self-hosted, on-premises product effective December 31, 2026, as part of its Q3 2025 results commentary.
Varonis reported Q2 2026 revenue of $180.0 million, up 18.3% year over year, and total SaaS ARR of $726.0 million, up 52% year over year, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Veeam completed its acquisition of Securiti AI, a data security posture management and AI-governance company, for $1.725 billion; Securiti founder and CEO Rehan Jalil joined Veeam as President of Security and AI.

WitnessAI raised a $58 million strategic funding round led by Sound Ventures, with participation from Fin Capital, Samsung Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, Forgepoint Capital Partners, Silver Buckshot Ventures, and existing investors Google Ventures and Ballistic Ventures.
Acquisition closed by Google/Alphabet at $29.5 billion after purchase price adjustments.

Zenity raised a $125 million Series C round led by Norwest, with participation from Qumra Capital, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Hitachi Ventures, LG Technology Ventures, Vertex Ventures, Third Point Ventures, DTCP, and Intel Capital.
Restructuring and other charges of $5.5 million in Q4 FY2026 and $10.3 million for full FY2026, described as severance and termination benefits.
Q4 FY2026 revenue $898.2 million, +25% YoY; ARR $3,771 million, +25% YoY.
CRO Mike Rich stepped down effective October 1, 2026, succeeded by Ross Tackett. EVP Raj Judge resigned board seat effective April 16, 2026.
Torq raised a $140 million Series D round led by Merlin Ventures at a $1.2 billion valuation.
Upwind raised a $250 million Series B round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, achieving unicorn status.
Chainguard raised $280 million in growth financing led by General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund.
Claroty raised $150 million in growth equity led by Golub Growth at a $3 billion valuation.
Xage closed a $15 million equity round led by Piva Capital in December 2025, reported 18 March 2026.
Mitsubishi Electric Corporation completed its acquisition of Nozomi Networks, which now operates as a wholly owned subsidiary while maintaining independent, vendor-neutral operations.

Four board members — Michael Burns, Benjamin Holzman, Thomas Schodorf, and Reeny Sondhi — resigned from the board, effective August 27, 2026, disclosed in an 8-K (Item 5.02). The filing states the resignations were not due to any disagreement with the company.
Arctic Wolf announced it acquired Sevco Security, an exposure assessment platform provider. Sevco's technology will operate on the Arctic Wolf Aurora Platform.
ServiceNow's fourth-quarter 2025 results release states that ServiceNow announced its intent to acquire Armis, and that the transaction was expected to close in the second half of 2026.

Check Point closed its offering of $2.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2030, including $250 million of additional notes. The Form 6-K states net proceeds were approximately $1.97 billion.
Cyera announced a $400 million Series F funding round led by funds managed by Blackstone, bringing its total funding to over $1.7 billion and its valuation to $9 billion.
Delinea announced it signed a definitive agreement to acquire StrongDM.
Delinea announced it completed its acquisition of StrongDM.

Accenture's release carries a note stating that the majority investment in Dragos closed on September 16, 2026, and that NetRise and runZero, which closed on July 31, 2026 and September 17, 2026, were acquired by Dragos as part of the closing terms.
Exabeam announced Pete Harteveld as Chief Executive Officer, following Chris O'Malley's decision to retire. Harteveld most recently served as Exabeam's Chief Revenue Officer.
Commvault disclosed in an 8-K that Chief Financial Officer Jennifer DiRico notified the company on November 30, 2025 that she will resign at the end of the calendar year.

Commvault announced the appointment of Gary Merrill as Chief Financial Officer and principal financial officer, effective April 13, 2026; he ceased to serve as Chief Commercial Officer as of that date.
Okta reported cRPO (current remaining performance obligations) of $2.585 billion at July 31, 2026, up 14% compared to the second quarter of fiscal 2026; RPO was $4.858 billion, up 17%.
Palo Alto Networks announced a definitive agreement to acquire Chronosphere for a total consideration of $3.35 billion, to be paid in cash and replacement equity awards, subject to adjustments.
Palo Alto Networks completed its acquisition of Chronosphere; Chronosphere continues as a wholly owned subsidiary of the company.
Proofpoint announced it had acquired Acuvity, an AI enterprise security and governance company.
Rapid7 disclosed in an 8-K that its board appointed Rafe Brown as Chief Financial Officer and principal financial officer, expected to be effective on or about December 1, 2025.

SentinelOne disclosed in an 8-K that Chief Financial Officer Barbara Larson notified the company on December 1, 2025 of her intention to resign, expected in mid-January 2026, and that Chief Growth Officer Barry Padgett would serve as interim Chief Financial Officer from her departure date.

SentinelOne disclosed in an 8-K that its board appointed Sonalee Parekh as Chief Financial Officer and principal financial officer on February 28, 2026, effective on a start date then set for March 24, 2026.

SailPoint completed its acquisition of Entro Security Ltd. and Entro Security Inc. on June 29, 2026 for total cash consideration of approximately $122.6 million, per its 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.

Veeam announced it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Securiti AI for $1.725 billion, with the transaction expected to close in the fourth quarter, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
Torq announced the acquisition of Jit, a Boston-based company it describes as an AI context graph cybersecurity company.
Upwind stated it is acquiring Aegis and launching the Upwind AI Lab.

Zscaler acquired all outstanding equity of SPLXAI Inc., an early-stage AI technology company, for cash consideration of $40.6 million, and issued $16.6 million in restricted stock subject to post-combination service vesting conditions.

Zscaler acquired all outstanding equity of SquareX Holdings, Inc., a browser security company, for cash consideration of $112.8 million, and issued $37.4 million in restricted stock subject to post-combination service vesting conditions.

Zscaler acquired all outstanding equity of Symmetry Systems, Inc. for cash consideration of $152.9 million, and issued $16.9 million in restricted stock subject to post-combination service vesting conditions.

Raj Judge, EVP of Corporate Strategy, informed Zscaler of his resignation on April 15, 2026, with departure effective July 31, 2026. He resigned as an officer and as a member of the Board of Directors effective April 15, 2026.

ReliaQuest announced that Krish Venkataraman will join the company as Chief Financial Officer on October 5, 2026. The company's release states he most recently served as Chief Financial Officer of Solink, and previously was President of Dataiku and Chief Financial Officer of Socure.
